description: Read the durable private event inbox, oldest unacknowledged first; paginate with after/next_after. This is event reconciliation, not the live wait/status snapshot. Reads never mark events handled. Durably queue or handle IDs before speedbot_ack_notifications. Existing notification preferences and opt-outs remain in effect. No automatic reply, acceptance or payment.

agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; verify a recovery wallet while authenticated to replace a lost key without losing identity. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.
